title: Sour Rest-Meat Pho
description: A unique and sour twist on the classic Vietnamese dish, featuring rest-meat and San Marzano tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Tamasic-friendly spices (such as cumin, coriander, and cinnamon)

instructions: Heat a large pan over medium heat and cook the rest-meat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the crushed San Marzano tomatoes, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the fermented fish sauce and rice vinegar to the pan and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the sour rest-meat mixture in a copper mug and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Enjoy your unique and sour Pho!
